_meta.scope: South Korea: Liquor Tax Act rates (official), Education Tax 30% of liquor tax (10% where the liquor tax rate is 30%), VAT 10% on CIF + duty + liquor tax + education tax. Customs duty from published MFN summaries — verify on UNI-PASS.
notes: Liquor tax: beer 885,700 won/kl (Act figure; the decree adjusts it yearly within ±30%), fruit wine/cheongju/sake 30% of value, distilled spirits (whisky, brandy, soju, vodka, gin, rum, liqueur) 72% of value. Value for imports = price at import declaration (customs value + duty).

Education tax: 30% of the liquor tax where the liquor tax rate is 70% or more (spirits, and beer); 10% where it is 30% (wine). Modelled by scaling the excise rate: spirits 72% × 1.3 = 93.6%; wine 30% × 1.1 = 33%; beer 885.7 × 1.3 = 1,151.41 won/L.

Customs duty (MFN, to verify): wine and sparkling 15%, beer 30%, whisky/vodka/gin/rum/liqueurs 20%, brandy 15%, cider/sake 15–30%. EU, US, Chile, Australia, UK, ASEAN (KORUS, EU-Korea FTA, RCEP…) are mostly 0% with origin certificate.
Tier indicative until the duty rows are taken from the national schedule and a declaration is checked.
